# A'sTechware

A'sTechware is an AI and software engineering partner for businesses that need production systems that actually work. We specialize in AI agent development, workflow automation, machine learning, platform modernization, custom software, API integrations, and DevOps. Milestone-based delivery, weekly demos, full code ownership, and natural exit points.

## Hiring & Engagement

- Hire AI engineers: https://astechware.com/hire-ai-engineers
- Hire dedicated developers: https://astechware.com/hire-dedicated-developers
- GCC delivery model (offshore engineering with senior oversight): https://astechware.com/gcc
- Fractional engineering team: extend capacity without full-time hires
- Forward deployed engineering: engineers embedded in operational context
- Engineering consultant engagements for architecture and automation scoping

## Founder

Ahmad Kamran — Founder & CEO. Leads strategy, client partnerships, and delivery. Focused on production-grade AI and platforms that scale, and a delivery model that gives clients full ownership and visibility.

Email: ahmad@astechware.com
Calendly: https://calendly.com/ahmadkamran/new-meeting

## Experience

Founded in 2022 as AsTechware LLC (Wyoming, USA) with an engineering team in Lahore, Pakistan. Team size 20–25. 50+ projects across industries. 100% client retention (all five-star reviews). Markets served: United States, Canada, Australia, and the United Kingdom; expanding into the GCC. Industries: healthcare, legal, financial, B2B SaaS, professional services, construction, logistics, home services, trucking, real estate, education technology.

## Technology Stack & Roles

Backend: Python (FastAPI), Node.js, Ruby on Rails
Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Flutter
AI/ML: LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic, pgvector
Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD
Integrations: Stripe, Twilio, QuickBooks Online, FHIR/HL7, DocuSign, RESO MLS, Microsoft 365

## Key Differentiators

Production-ready systems with error handling, monitoring, and failover from day one. AI with governance: human-in-the-loop and audit trails built in for compliance-sensitive workflows. Healthcare voice and scribe work is described as HIPAA-ready architecture (PHI boundaries, BAAs, audit design)—not claimed as HIPAA certified/compliant unless the client's program is certified. Complete ownership: clients own all code, infrastructure, and documentation; no lock-in. Measurable results: hours saved, revenue recovered, capacity increased. Milestone-based delivery with weekly demos and natural exit points.
